en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand central square with historic buildings. A large eclectic-style city hall with a tall clock tower dominates the left side, while other multi‑story buildings and a church frame the square. People and shop awnings are visible around the plaza. The caption at the bottom of the image reads "Pécs" on the left and "Széchenyi tér" on the right. The reverse side has standard divided‑back postcard layout with Hungarian instructions about postage and the publisher's mark "Foto Weinstock".
